name: True Colors of 3/4oz
source: The man, who was the victim of mass stalking, said something strange that he was being tapped further. Meanwhile, at that time, Otomo met with a serial killer man in a detention center. Taking the opportunity of a certain AD suicide, the incident leads to "the secret of humankind".
